-- precedence and arithmetic corners a printer has to parenthesize or keep apart: unary minus
-- against ^, not against ==, right-associative .. and ^, and Luau's floor division and modulo with
-- negative and fractional operands
local values = { 7, -7, 2.5, -2.5, 0.5, 3 }
for _, a in ipairs(values) do
	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do
		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))
print(1 .. 2, 1 .. 2 .. 3, "a" .. 1 + 2, ("a" .. 1) .. 2)
print(x < y == true, (x < y) == true, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x * y % 4, x * (y % 4))
print(#"abc" + 1, #{ 1, 2 } * 2, -#"ab", #("a" .. "bc"))
print(7 // 0, -7 // 0, 0 / 0 ~= 0 / 0, -7 % math.huge, 7 % -math.huge)
print(2 ^ 53 + 1, 2 ^ 63, -2 ^ 63, 1e308 * 10, -1e308 * 10)

-- the same expressions on values the compiler can't fold
local function id(v)
	return v
end
local p, q = id(-7), id(2)
print(p // q, p % q, -p ^ q, (p .. q), p < q and "lt" or "ge", not (p < q))

-- comparisons the printer might swap or merge
local function order(a, b)
	return a < b, a > b, b < a, a <= b, not (a > b), a == b, a ~= b
end
print(order(1, 2))
print(order("a", "b"))
print(order(2, 2))

-- precedence and arithmetic corners a printer has to parenthesize or keep apart: unary minus
-- against ^, not against ==, right-associative .. and ^, and Luau's floor division and modulo with
-- negative and fractional operands
local values = { 7, -7, 2.5, -2.5, 0.5, 3 }
for _, a in ipairs(values) do
	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do
		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))
print(1 .. 2, 1 .. 2 .. 3, "a" .. 1 + 2, ("a" .. 1) .. 2)
print(x < y == true, (x < y) == true, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x * y % 4, x * (y % 4))
print(#"abc" + 1, #{ 1, 2 } * 2, -#"ab", #("a" .. "bc"))
print(7 // 0, -7 // 0, 0 / 0 ~= 0 / 0, -7 % math.huge, 7 % -math.huge)
print(2 ^ 53 + 1, 2 ^ 63, -2 ^ 63, 1e308 * 10, -1e308 * 10)

-- the same expressions on values the compiler can't fold
local function id(v)
	return v
end
local p, q = id(-7), id(2)
print(p // q, p % q, -p ^ q, (p .. q), p < q and "lt" or "ge", not (p < q))

-- comparisons the printer might swap or merge
local function order(a, b)
	return a < b, a > b, b < a, a <= b, not (a > b), a == b, a ~= b
end
print(order(1, 2))
print(order("a", "b"))
print(order(2, 2))

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

local Shapes = {}
Shapes.util = {}

function Shapes.util.area(w, h)
	return w * h
end

function Shapes.new(kind, w, h)
	return setmetatable({ kind = kind, w = w, h = h }, { __index = Shapes })
end

function Shapes:describe()
	return self.kind .. " " .. Shapes.util.area(self.w, self.h)
end

local function parse(text)
	local n = tonumber(text)
	if n == nil then
		error("not a number: " .. text)
	end
	return n
end

print(success, result)

print(okay, (string.gsub(err, "^.-: ", "")))

local items = { Shapes.new("square", 2, 2), Shapes.new("strip", 1, 9) }
for i, shape in ipairs(items) do
	print(i, shape:describe())
end

local keys = {}
for key, value in pairs(totals) do
	table.insert(keys, key .. "=" .. value)
end
print(table.concat(keys))

local name = items[3] and items[3].kind or "none"
print(name)

local x
if #items > 1 then
	x = "many"
else
	x = "few"
end
print(x)

-- shapes the printer turns back into source sugar
local Shapes = {}
Shapes.util = {}

function Shapes.util.area(w, h)
	return w * h
end

function Shapes.new(kind, w, h)
	return setmetatable({ kind = kind, w = w, h = h }, { __index = Shapes })
end

function Shapes:describe()
	return self.kind .. " " .. Shapes.util.area(self.w, self.h)
end

local function parse(text)
	local n = tonumber(text)
	if n == nil then
		error("not a number: " .. text)
	end
	return n
end

local success, result = pcall(parse, "12")
print(success, result)
local okay, err = pcall(parse, "twelve")
print(okay, (string.gsub(err, "^.-: ", "")))

local items = { Shapes.new("square", 2, 2), Shapes.new("strip", 1, 9) }
for i, shape in ipairs(items) do
	print(i, shape:describe())
end

local totals = { a = 1 }
local keys = {}
for key, value in pairs(totals) do
	table.insert(keys, key .. "=" .. value)
end
print(table.concat(keys))

local name = items[3] and items[3].kind or "none"
print(name)

local x
if #items > 1 then
	x = "many"
else
	x = "few"
end
print(x)

-- shapes the new core used to refuse, mostly what -O2 inlining leaves behind

-- a local declared first, then a function that calls itself through it
local count = 0
local tick
tick = function(n)
	count += 1
	if n > 0 then
		tick(n - 1)
	end
end
tick(3)

-- a helper with a loop, inlined into a condition
local function isInside(node, kind)
	while node ~= nil do
		if node.kind == kind then
			return true
		end
		node = node.parent
	end
	return false
end
local tree = { kind = "leaf", parent = { kind = "quote", parent = { kind = "doc" } } }
local function check(start, kind)
	local found = start ~= nil
	if found and isInside(start, kind) then
		return "inside " .. kind
	end
	return "outside " .. kind
end

-- a helper with early returns and a local the next tests compare against
local A = { Asset = 1, Bundle = 2, Look = 3 }
local B = { GamePass = 4, Product = 5 }
local function isSupported(payload, requestType)
	if type(payload) == "table" then
		local kind = payload.kind
		if kind == A.Asset or kind == A.Bundle or kind == A.Look then
			return true
		end
	end
	if requestType == B.GamePass or requestType == B.Product then
		return true
	end
	return false
end
local function pick(state)
	if state == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if not isSupported(state.payload, state.request and state.request.kind) then
		return nil
	end
	return state.price
end

-- a loop whose end is the end of the function, through an if
local function scan(list, limit)
	if #list > 0 then
		local i = 0
		repeat
			i += 1
			if list[i] == limit then
				count += 100
				break
			end
		until i >= #list
	elseif limit then
		count += 1
	end
end
scan({ 1, 2, 3 }, 2)
scan({}, true)

-- an `or` chain of method calls on locals, each part a boolean
local function curve(keys)
	return { IsA = function(_, class) return class == "FloatCurve" end, GetKeys = function() return keys end }
end
local function hasKeys(folder)
	local X = folder.X
	local Y = folder.Y
	local Z = folder.Z
	return (if X then X:IsA("FloatCurve") and #X:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
		or (if Y then Y:IsA("FloatCurve") and #Y:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
		or (if Z then Z:IsA("FloatCurve") and #Z:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
end
print(hasKeys({ X = curve({}), Z = curve({ 1 }) }), hasKeys({}), hasKeys({ Y = curve({ 1, 2 }) }))

local flag = count > 3
print(count, check(tree, "quote"), check(tree, "table"), check(nil, "doc"))
print(pick({ payload = { kind = 2 }, price = 7 }), pick({ payload = 1, request = { kind = 5 }, price = 8 }), pick({ payload = {}, price = 9 }))
print((flag and nil) or flag, (count > 1000 and (flag and nil)) or "no")

-- shapes the new core used to refuse, mostly what -O2 inlining leaves behind

-- a local declared first, then a function that calls itself through it
local count = 0
local tick
tick = function(n)
	count += 1
	if n > 0 then
		tick(n - 1)
	end
end
tick(3)

-- a helper with a loop, inlined into a condition
local function isInside(node, kind)
	while node ~= nil do
		if node.kind == kind then
			return true
		end
		node = node.parent
	end
	return false
end
local tree = { kind = "leaf", parent = { kind = "quote", parent = { kind = "doc" } } }
local function check(start, kind)
	local found = start ~= nil
	if found and isInside(start, kind) then
		return "inside " .. kind
	end
	return "outside " .. kind
end

-- a helper with early returns and a local the next tests compare against
local A = { Asset = 1, Bundle = 2, Look = 3 }
local B = { GamePass = 4, Product = 5 }
local function isSupported(payload, requestType)
	if type(payload) == "table" then
		local kind = payload.kind
		if kind == A.Asset or kind == A.Bundle or kind == A.Look then
			return true
		end
	end
	if requestType == B.GamePass or requestType == B.Product then
		return true
	end
	return false
end
local function pick(state)
	if state == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if not isSupported(state.payload, state.request and state.request.kind) then
		return nil
	end
	return state.price
end

-- a loop whose end is the end of the function, through an if
local function scan(list, limit)
	if #list > 0 then
		local i = 0
		repeat
			i += 1
			if list[i] == limit then
				count += 100
				break
			end
		until i >= #list
	elseif limit then
		count += 1
	end
end
scan({ 1, 2, 3 }, 2)
scan({}, true)

-- an `or` chain of method calls on locals, each part a boolean
local function curve(keys)
	return { IsA = function(_, class) return class == "FloatCurve" end, GetKeys = function() return keys end }
end
local function hasKeys(folder)
	local X = folder.X
	local Y = folder.Y
	local Z = folder.Z
	return (if X then X:IsA("FloatCurve") and #X:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
		or (if Y then Y:IsA("FloatCurve") and #Y:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
		or (if Z then Z:IsA("FloatCurve") and #Z:GetKeys() > 0 else false)
end
print(hasKeys({ X = curve({}), Z = curve({ 1 }) }), hasKeys({}), hasKeys({ Y = curve({ 1, 2 }) }))

local flag = count > 3
print(count, check(tree, "quote"), check(tree, "table"), check(nil, "doc"))
print(pick({ payload = { kind = 2 }, price = 7 }), pick({ payload = 1, request = { kind = 5 }, price = 8 }), pick({ payload = {}, price = 9 }))
print((flag and nil) or flag, (count > 1000 and (flag and nil)) or "no")

-- naming that leans on Roblox conventions, run against small stand-ins for the real APIs
local Class = {}
Class.__index = Class

function Class.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable({ x = x }, Class)
	local other = setmetatable({ x = -x }, Class)
	obj.peer = other
	function obj.get()
		return obj.x + other.x
	end
	return obj
end

function Class:clone()
	local copy = setmetatable({ x = self.x }, Class)
	return copy
end

function Class:spawner()
	return function(n)
		local inner = setmetatable({ x = self.x + n }, Class)
		return inner
	end
end

local Sub = setmetatable({}, { __index = Class })
Sub.__index = Sub
function Sub.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable(Class.new(x), Sub)
	obj.sub = true
	return obj
end

local function signal()
	local handlers = {}
	return {
		Connect = function(_, f)
			table.insert(handlers, f)
		end,
		Fire = function(_, ...)
			for _, f in handlers do
				f(...)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local Players = { PlayerAdded = signal(), Stepped = signal() }
local log = {}
local function onStep(t, dt)
	table.insert(log, t + dt)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	table.insert(log, plr .. " joined")
end)
Players.Stepped:Connect(onStep)
Players.PlayerAdded:Fire("luna")
Players.Stepped:Fire(1, 0.5)

local folder = {}
function folder:GetChildren()
	return { "a", "b", "c" }
end
for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
	table.insert(log, item)
end
for index, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(log, index .. item)
end

local a, b = Class.new(2), Sub.new(5)
print(a.get(), a:clone().x, a:spawner()(3).x, b.sub, b.get(), table.concat(log, ","))

-- naming that leans on Roblox conventions, run against small stand-ins for the real APIs
local Class = {}
Class.__index = Class

function Class.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable({ x = x }, Class)
	local other = setmetatable({ x = -x }, Class)
	obj.peer = other
	function obj.get()
		return obj.x + other.x
	end
	return obj
end

function Class:clone()
	local copy = setmetatable({ x = self.x }, Class)
	return copy
end

function Class:spawner()
	return function(n)
		local inner = setmetatable({ x = self.x + n }, Class)
		return inner
	end
end

local Sub = setmetatable({}, { __index = Class })
Sub.__index = Sub
function Sub.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable(Class.new(x), Sub)
	obj.sub = true
	return obj
end

local function signal()
	local handlers = {}
	return {
		Connect = function(_, f)
			table.insert(handlers, f)
		end,
		Fire = function(_, ...)
			for _, f in handlers do
				f(...)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local Players = { PlayerAdded = signal(), Stepped = signal() }
local log = {}
local function onStep(t, dt)
	table.insert(log, t + dt)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	table.insert(log, plr .. " joined")
end)
Players.Stepped:Connect(onStep)
Players.PlayerAdded:Fire("luna")
Players.Stepped:Fire(1, 0.5)

local folder = {}
function folder:GetChildren()
	return { "a", "b", "c" }
end
for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
	table.insert(log, item)
end
for index, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(log, index .. item)
end

local a, b = Class.new(2), Sub.new(5)
print(a.get(), a:clone().x, a:spawner()(3).x, b.sub, b.get(), table.concat(log, ","))

-- naming that leans on Roblox conventions, run against small stand-ins for the real APIs
local Class = {}
Class.__index = Class

function Class.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable({ x = x }, Class)
	local other = setmetatable({ x = -x }, Class)
	obj.peer = other
	function obj.get()
		return obj.x + other.x
	end
	return obj
end

function Class:clone()
	local copy = setmetatable({ x = self.x }, Class)
	return copy
end

function Class:spawner()
	return function(n)
		local inner = setmetatable({ x = self.x + n }, Class)
		return inner
	end
end

local Sub = setmetatable({}, { __index = Class })
Sub.__index = Sub
function Sub.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable(Class.new(x), Sub)
	obj.sub = true
	return obj
end

local function signal()
	local handlers = {}
	return {
		Connect = function(_, f)
			table.insert(handlers, f)
		end,
		Fire = function(_, ...)
			for _, f in handlers do
				f(...)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local Players = { PlayerAdded = signal(), Stepped = signal() }
local log = {}
local function onStep(t, dt)
	table.insert(log, t + dt)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	table.insert(log, plr .. " joined")
end)
Players.Stepped:Connect(onStep)
Players.PlayerAdded:Fire("luna")
Players.Stepped:Fire(1, 0.5)

local folder = {}
function folder:GetChildren()
	return { "a", "b", "c" }
end
for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
	table.insert(log, item)
end
for index, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(log, index .. item)
end

local a, b = Class.new(2), Sub.new(5)
print(a.get(), a:clone().x, a:spawner()(3).x, b.sub, b.get(), table.concat(log, ","))

do
	local function scan(s)
		local depth, out = 0, {}
		local i = 1
		while i <= #s do
			local c = string.sub(s, i, i)
			if c == "(" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == ")" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth < 0 then
					return "unbalanced at " .. i
				end
			elseif c == "x" and depth == 0 then
				table.insert(out, i)
			else
				i += 1
				continue
			end
			i += 1
		end
		if depth ~= 0 then
			return "open"
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(scan("x(x)x"), scan("(()"), scan("())x"), scan(""))

-- locals that are written inside a loop and read after it, or in a repeat's condition
do
	local function scan(s)
		local depth, out = 0, {}
		local i = 1
		while i <= #s do
			local c = string.sub(s, i, i)
			if c == "(" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == ")" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth < 0 then
					return "unbalanced at " .. i
				end
			elseif c == "x" and depth == 0 then
				table.insert(out, i)
			else
				i += 1
				continue
			end
			i += 1
		end
		if depth ~= 0 then
			return "open"
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(scan("x(x)x"), scan("(()"), scan("())x"), scan(""))
end

-- locals that are written inside a loop and read after it, or in a repeat's condition
do
	local function scan(s)
		local depth, out = 0, {}
		local i = 1
		while i <= #s do
			local c = string.sub(s, i, i)
			if c == "(" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == ")" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth < 0 then
					return "unbalanced at " .. i
				end
			elseif c == "x" and depth == 0 then
				table.insert(out, i)
			else
				i += 1
				continue
			end
			i += 1
		end
		if depth ~= 0 then
			return "open"
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(scan("x(x)x"), scan("(()"), scan("())x"), scan(""))
end

	end

end

-- naming hints: services, children, modules, instances
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local damageEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("Damage")
local config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

local marker = Instance.new("Part")
marker.Anchored = true
marker.CanCollide = false
marker.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
marker.Parent = workspace

local started = tick()
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		marker.Position = character:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, config.MarkerHeight, 0)
	end
	if tick() - started > config.Lifetime then
		marker:Destroy()
	end
end)

damageEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(amount, source)
	print(("took %d damage from %s"):format(amount, source.Name))
end)

-- table constructors: positional entries overwrite earlier [1] =, a call or ... last expands but
-- anywhere else gives one value, nil holes, and keys that need brackets
local function two()
	return "a", "b"
end
local function show(t, n)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		out[i] = tostring(t[i])
	end
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

print(show({ [1] = "x", "y" }, 2))
print(show({ "y", [1] = "x" }, 2))
print(show({ two() }, 3), show({ two(), "c" }, 3), show({ (two()) }, 3), show({ two(), two() }, 4))
print(show({ nil, 2, nil, 4 }, 4), select("#", table.unpack({ 1, nil, 3 }, 1, 3)))

local function pack(...)
	return { ... }, { n = select("#", ...), ... }, { ..., "last" }
end
local a, b, c = pack(1, nil, 3)
print(show(a, 3), b.n, show(b, 3), show(c, 3))

local k = "dyn"
local t = {
	plain = 1,
	["with space"] = 2,
	["end"] = 3,
	[k] = 4,
	[k .. "2"] = 5,
	[10] = 6,
	[-1] = 7,
	[1.5] = 8,
	[true] = 9,
	nested = { deep = { deeper = { 10 } } },
	fn = function(self)
		return self.plain
	end,
	"pos1",
	"pos2",
}
print(t.plain, t["with space"], t["end"], t.dyn, t.dyn2, t[10], t[-1], t[1.5], t[true])
print(t.nested.deep.deeper[1], t:fn(), t[1], t[2], #t)

-- the same key twice: the later one wins
local dup = { x = 1, x = 2, [2] = "a", "b", "c" }
print(dup.x, dup[1], dup[2])

-- assignment chains through fresh tables
local root = {}
root.a = {}
root.a.b = {}
root.a.b.c = "set"
root["a"]["b"].d = root.a.b.c .. "!"
print(root.a.b.c, root.a.b.d)

-- tables, varargs, multiple returns and string building
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end

local function minMax(...)
	local args = pack(...)
	local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
	for i = 1, args.n do
		lo = math.min(lo, args[i])
		hi = math.max(hi, args[i])
	end
	return lo, hi
end

	volume = 0.8,

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do

local function key(x, y)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

local vr = false

	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end

	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-147 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

	if vr then

	return true

	return a and b and supported()
end

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }

local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end

local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack

end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-147 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
repeat
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
until true
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-147 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
repeat
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
until true
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)

	return y * 1000 + x

end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}

function Heap.new()

			smallest = left

		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right

			break

		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()

	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()

	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)

end

local function parse(rows)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-286 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for

	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end

	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do

for _ = 1, 1 do

			end
		end

	end
	return false

	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"

	return a and b and supported()
end

end)()

	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end

	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
repeat
		node = node.parent
until true
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end

local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end

onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true

			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end

local vr = false

	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
until true
local _ = (function()

	return a and b and supported()
end

end)()
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
repeat
		node = node.parent
until true
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end

onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

	if kind == "click" then

local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end

flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do

			end
		end

	return false

	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"

	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end

	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then

	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")

	if kind == "click" then

for _ = 1, 2 do

end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then

end
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then

end
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)

local function heuristic(a, b)

		i = smallest

	return top.node

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)

	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",

	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"

			elseif c == "G" then

			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

	return y * 1000 + x

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1

			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`

	"...#....#G",

	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

	return y * 1000 + x

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

			smallest = left

			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

Heap.__index = Heap

	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)

		end

		i = smallest
	end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

-- rosetta mutant mut1-414 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for, early return, string
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do

end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"

				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

			smallest = left

		i = smallest
	end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)

local function parse(rows)

			elseif c == "G" then

			end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
