-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
while true do
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
break
end
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)

			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then

		end

		i = smallest

	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-622 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat, wrap do, duplicate, duplicate
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
do
			return urls.delivery
end
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

	return true

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	"\255",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
local _ = (function()
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
end)()
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-773 of generalized_iteration: duplicate, wrap do, wrap local function with args, delete, early return, wrap while, negate, wrap for twice, early return, wrap for
-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
for _ = 1, 1 do
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",

	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

			break

		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent

function Heap:pop()

		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }

				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)

			end
			return path, visited
		end

			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))

		end

	return nil, visited

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()

			break

		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end

function Heap:pop()

until true

		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then

			return path, visited

			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited

local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end
